Subject: Sponsor creative & RSVP fallback plan — Inbound webinar Apr 27

Team —

Quick sync on Acme (sponsor) creative and RSVP routing. They just sent a partial assets bundle and asked for co-branded placements. We need a fallback plan if any asset is bad or late and finalize tracking links for the RSVP cadence. Key asks: 

1) Confirm final RSVP copy variants for: Priority Architects list (US), General Dev list (EMEA), and Field engineers (APAC waves). I want short (single-line CTA) + long variant (one-sentence benefit).
2) Confirm tracking link pattern we’ll use (UTM parameters + hubspot query id). We need stable mapping so sponsor can reconcile.
3) If logos fail to render in some clients, we’ll use a text-only sponsor acknowledgement; need final alt text.
4) Attachments: Acme sent a .zip with logos — I’ve added it to Drive and attached the filename below.

Proposed cadence (we can tweak):
- Invite send: Tue Apr 27 09:00 PT (wave 1: US architects)
- Reminder 1: +48 hours
- Reminder 2: +7 days (final)
- Day-of: 90 minutes prior (includes calendar add)

Ben, can you draft the 2 copy variants and the UTM mapping? Marissa, please build the HubSpot sequence (HS-67213) and schedule a test send to our internal test seed list in the same timezone windows. Olga — I’ll need your help on the sponsor placement rules (logo size/alt text + fallback).

Attachments: acme_brand_assets.zip (contains: logo_rgb.svg, logo_white.png, sponsor_guidelines.pdf)

Thanks —
Lauren
Director, Event Ops
Redwood Inference

SHORT (CTA-focused)
Join the April 27 webinar: Speed up LLM inference — Save your seat → [RSVP]

LONG (benefit + CTA)

UTM/tracking pattern (proposal):
- Base RSVP: https://redwood-inference.app/rsvp?event=april27&hs=HS-67213
- Add: &utm_source=email&utm_medium=sponsor&utm_campaign=acme_april27&utm_content={segment}
- {segment} values: architects_us | devs_eu | field_apac

Fallback alt text for logo: "Acme Platform — AI infrastructure partner"

I’ll drop a CSV with the link-per-segment mapping and a test link (shortened) in Drive by 12:00 PT.
